notch.unpin: Let the panel close by itself

empty.title: Nothing to show yet
empty.body: Modules appear here as they are added.

dropFinished.trash_one: Moved {{count}} item to the recycle bin
dropFinished.trash_other: Moved {{count}} items to the recycle bin

dropFailed.reveal: Could not show in File Explorer
dropFailed.shelf: Could not add to the Shelf

describe.agentDecision: {{agent}} wants to run {{tool}}, allow or deny
describe.healthBreak: Time for a break, you have been sitting {{duration}}

spike.label: Muna window spike
spike.hint: Press Ctrl+Alt+M to morph, Ctrl+Alt+P to park, Ctrl+Alt+C to hide from captures.

empty.title: Nothing playing
empty.body: Play something in Spotify, a browser or another app and it appears here.

settings.preferredAppBody: Automatic follows whichever app is playing. Choosing an app keeps the notch on it while it has something to show.
settings.refreshBody: Ask Windows again for the apps that are playing, if one seems stuck.
settings.adaptiveColoursBody: Tints the strip and panel with colours from the album art.
settings.visualiserBody: Audio bars beside the art while music plays.

settings.replaceSystemFlyoutBody: Hides the Windows volume and brightness pop-up while Muna runs. If Muna stops unexpectedly, the pop-up comes back within two seconds.
settings.flyoutUnavailable: Not found yet. It appears after the first volume key press.
settings.scrollOnStripBody: What the mouse wheel does over the closed strip. Volume works there whenever the level is showing.
settings.showLevelTextBody: Shows the percentage beside the level track.
settings.muteBody: Silences the default output. Turning the volume up unmutes.
settings.micMuteBody: Mutes the default microphone for every app.
settings.brightnessBody: Each display that can be adjusted. Displays without DDC/CI are not listed.

pomodoro.title: Pomodoro
pomodoro.cycle: {{done}} of {{total}} focus phases before the long break
pomodoro.finishedAsleep: {{phase}} finished while the PC was asleep

settings.longBreakEveryBody: How many focus phases make a cycle. The break after the last one is the long one.
settings.autoStartNextBody: Breaks and focus phases follow each other without a tap. A changed length applies to the next phase that starts.

todo.title: Tasks
todo.retention_one: Deleted tasks are removed after 1 day
todo.retention_other: Deleted tasks are removed after {{count}} days
todo.empty: Type a task above and press Enter
todo.emptyBody: Add a date in words, like tomorrow 3pm, to set when it is due.
todo.trashEmptyBody_one: A task you move to the trash stays here for 1 day and can be restored.
todo.trashEmptyBody_other: A task you move to the trash stays here for {{count}} days and can be restored.

settings.retentionDaysBody: After this, tasks in the trash are removed for good.
settings.showDueInStrip: Show the next due task in the strip
settings.showDueInStripBody: Appears an hour before a timed task is due and stays 15 minutes after. All-day tasks never show.
settings.dueNotices: Announce a task when it is due
settings.dueNoticesBody: A short notice in the strip at the due time.
settings.listsBody: Tasks live in one list each. Deleting a list moves its tasks to the trash.

settings.showCpuInStripBody: A small processor gauge in the collapsed strip, refreshed every 10 seconds. Without it, nothing is measured while the panel is closed.
settings.processCountBody: The busiest processes, most CPU first. Set to none to hide the list and skip the process walk.

bluetooth.title: Bluetooth
bluetooth.radioBody: Turn the radio off to stop every device at once.

error.notFound: This device is no longer paired

empty.title: No paired devices
empty.body: Pair a device in Windows Settings and it will appear here.

off.title: Bluetooth is off
off.body: Turn it on to see your devices.

unavailable.title: Bluetooth is not available
unavailable.body: This PC has no Bluetooth radio, or Windows will not let Muna use it.

settings.lowBatteryNoticesBody: Announce a connected device in the strip when its battery reaches 20 % and again at 10 %.
settings.devicesBody: Paired devices you hide stay paired; they just leave the list.

off.title: Weather is off
off.body: Turn it on in settings to see the forecast. Muna then asks Open-Meteo for it every quarter hour.

locating.title: Finding your location
locating.body: Windows is working out where you are.

chooseCity.title: Choose a city
chooseCity.denied: Windows is not sharing your location with Muna. Pick a city in settings, or allow location for desktop apps and try again.
chooseCity.unavailable: This PC has no location source. Pick a city in settings.
chooseCity.failed: Your location could not be found just now. Muna will try again shortly.

offline.title: You seem to be offline
offline.body: The forecast will refresh when you are back online.

provider.title: The weather service is having trouble

settings.privacy: Weather is off until you turn it on. When on, Muna sends only rounded coordinates to Open-Meteo, a free forecast service with no account, and keeps the last forecast on this PC.
settings.showBody: Fetches a forecast every quarter hour while Muna runs.
settings.locationBody: Current location asks Windows once and rounds the answer to about a kilometre.
settings.noResults: No places match. Try the nearest larger town.
settings.searchOff: Turn on weather to search for a city.
settings.searchFailed: The place search is not answering; try again shortly.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.outsideWindow: Only the sixty days around today are loaded.

empty.title: No calendars yet
empty.body: Add a calendar link in Settings and your events show here, and in the strip before they start.

settings.privacy: Muna fetches each calendar link from this PC on the period below. Links stay in Windows Credential Manager and never appear in the settings file or an export.
settings.addBody: Paste the ICS or webcal link your calendar app offers under share, publish or subscribe.
settings.name: Name
settings.added: Added {{name}}. Its events arrive in a moment.

addFailed.malformed: That is not a web link.
addFailed.scheme: Only https and webcal links work.
addFailed.credentials: Remove the user name and password from the link.
addFailed.vault: Windows could not store the link. Try again.
addFailed.failed: That did not work. Try again.

status.refused: The link was refused. It may have expired; add the calendar again.
status.invalid: The link did not return a calendar.
status.missingLink: The link is missing on this PC. Remove the calendar and add it again.

settings.refreshBody: How often each calendar link is fetched while Muna runs.
settings.showNextInStrip: Show the next event in the strip
settings.showNextInStripBody: An event within the hour takes the strip with a countdown and outranks music ten minutes before it starts.
settings.noticesBody: A short notice in the strip with the event's title.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.focusOnBody: Notices wait while a focus session is on. Open Windows focus settings.

error.notFound: Windows could not open it; the notification may have gone

empty.title: No notifications
empty.body: New ones show here as they arrive.

unspecified.title: Let Muna show your notifications
unspecified.body: Windows asks once. Notifications stay on this PC and are never logged.

denied.title: Notifications are turned off for Muna
denied.body: Turn them on under Settings › Privacy › Notifications, then check again.

unavailable.title: Notifications are not available
unavailable.body: This Windows has no notification listener for apps to read.

accessState.allowed: Allowed. Muna reads the Action Center on this PC only.
accessState.unspecified: Windows has not been asked yet.

settings.deliveryPollingBody: This build has no package identity, so Windows cannot tell Muna when something changes. The Store build hears about changes at once.
settings.arrivalNoticesBody: A short notice in the strip with the sender and title, held back while Windows says you are busy or a focus session is on.
settings.showUnreadInStripBody: The latest sender and the unread count stay in the strip until you open the panel.
settings.mutedAppsBody: Muted apps stay in the panel but are never announced or counted. Mute one from its row in the panel.

dayProgress.title: Day
dayProgress.workingDayLabel: Share of the working day that has passed

empty.title: Nothing on the timeline yet
empty.body: Give a task a due time today, or start a focus session, and it shows up here.

settings.hoursBody: The stretch the day bar and the free-time hint cover.
settings.showBedtimeBody: Ends the timeline with a bedtime of your choosing.
settings.showDayInStrip: Show the day bar in the strip
settings.showDayInStripBody: A small bar of the working day in the collapsed strip, during working hours only.
settings.showTasksBody: Tasks with a due time today, from the to-do module.
settings.showFocusSessionsBody: The running pomodoro phase and today's count.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.hint: Drag a widget onto another to swap places, or use its arrows

empty.title: No widgets on the grid
empty.body: Choose Edit layout to add the cards you want to see.

settings.layoutBody: Arrange the grid from the dashboard itself: choose Edit layout in the panel.
settings.resetBody: Puts every widget back in its default place and size.

settings.shellBody: Global shortcuts work in any app. Press a row's shortcut to change it; Backspace clears it and Esc keeps it.
settings.openModuleBody: Numbers follow the order of the bar, left to right.
settings.onlyWhileHoveringBody: Shortcuts act only while the pointer is over the notch.
settings.snoozeBody: How long the notch stays out of the way after {{chord}}.

settings.enabled: Show actions when files are dragged over the notch
settings.enabledBody: Off leaves the notch alone during a drag.
settings.expandNotchBody: Widens the row to eight tiles.
settings.tilesBody: The row in order, left to right. Hidden tiles stay here so they can come back.
settings.addDividerBody: A gap that separates groups of tiles.
settings.foldersBody: Each folder becomes a tile that copies or moves dropped files into it.
settings.foldersEmpty: No folders yet. Add one to copy or move files into it with a single drop.
settings.addFolderFull: Remove a folder to add another.
settings.pickFolderTitle: Choose a folder for dropped files
settings.mode: What a drop does with the files in {{name}}
settings.activityBody: Files being zipped or unzipped right now.

shelf.title: Shelf
shelf.paste: Paste text or a link, then Enter
shelf.emptyBody: Drop files on the notch and choose Shelf, or paste text above. Drag items out to any app.

settings.copyIntoStorageBody: Items keep working after the original is moved or deleted. Copies go when the item does.
settings.expiryBody: Items older than this leave the Shelf on their own.
settings.clearBody: Removes every item. Copies in Shelf storage are deleted; original files are not touched.

settings.zonesBody: Drag any window to the notch and release over a zone. Up to {{max}} zones in all, grid cells included.
settings.gridBody: Equal cells with a gap between them. Cells count towards the zone limit and appear after the zones.

error.offlineNoCache: Offline. The queue appears when the connection is back.
error.unauthorized: GitHub no longer accepts the token. Connect again in Settings.
error.rateLimited: GitHub asked for a pause. The queue refreshes in a while.
error.provider: GitHub answered with something unexpected. Muna tries again in a while.

off.title: Code hosting is off
off.body: Turn it on in Settings and connect a GitHub account to see pull requests waiting on you.

connect.title: No account connected
connect.body: Connect a GitHub account in Settings with a token that can read your repositories.

toReview.title: Nothing to review
toReview.body: Pull requests that ask for your review appear here within a couple of minutes.

mine.title: No open pull requests of yours
mine.body: Your own open pull requests and their checks appear here.

all.title: No open pull requests
all.body: Pull requests that ask for your review, and your own, appear here.

widget.label: Review queue
widget.connect: Connect a GitHub account in Settings

settings.privacy: Muna asks api.github.com for open pull requests that mention you every two minutes while it runs. The token stays in Windows Credential Manager and never appears in the settings file, an export or the log.
settings.enabledBody: Lists pull requests waiting for your review and your own, with their checks.
settings.connectBody: Paste a personal access token that can read the repositories you review. Fine-grained tokens need Pull requests and Metadata read access.
settings.connectedBody: Signed in to {{provider}}. Disconnect to forget the token and the queue.

connectFailed.malformed: That does not look like a token. Paste it without spaces or quotes.
connectFailed.offline: GitHub could not be reached. Check the connection and try again.
connectFailed.unauthorized: GitHub refused the token. Check that it can read your repositories and has not expired.
connectFailed.rateLimited: GitHub asked for a pause. Try again in a few minutes.
connectFailed.provider: GitHub answered with something unexpected. Try again.
connectFailed.vault: Windows could not store the token. Try again.
connectFailed.failed: That did not work. Try again.

settings.reviewRequestedBody: A pull request that newly asks for your review shows in the strip for a moment.
settings.checksFinishedBody: When the checks on one of your pull requests pass or fail, the strip says so.

notes.title: Notes
notes.conflict: This note changed in another app and was reloaded.
notes.saveFailed: The note could not be saved. Check the folder and try again.

tooLarge.title: Too large to edit here
tooLarge.body: Notes over 2 MB open in your default app instead.

noResults.title: No notes match
noResults.body: Try another word, or clear the search.

empty.title: No notes yet
empty.body: Create one above, or use the quick note shortcut to jot something into Inbox.

missing.title: The notes folder is missing
missing.body: {{folder}} cannot be found. Plug the drive back in, or choose another folder in Settings.

unreadable.title: The notes folder cannot be read
unreadable.body: Check that Muna may read {{folder}}, or choose another folder in Settings.

widget.label: Notes
widget.empty: Pin a note to keep it here
widget.problem: The notes folder is not available

settings.folderBody: Plain Markdown files, one per note. Point it at an Obsidian vault or any folder to share notes with other apps.
settings.missing: This folder cannot be found right now.
settings.quickNoteBody: Opens Inbox in the notch with the cursor at the end. Set a shortcut for it under Keyboard shortcuts.

now.label: Now
now.idleBody: Time stops counting until you are back.
now.lockedBody: Time stops counting until you unlock.
now.offBody: Turn it on in Settings to start counting.
now.nothingBody: Switch to another app to start the count.

detail.limitBody: The notch nudges you once when the app passes this today.
detail.excludeBody: Forgets its history and stops counting it. You can include it again in Settings.

error.unknown: That app is not in the history any more.
error.io: The file could not be written. Choose another folder and try again.
error.failed: That did not work. Try again.

settings.enabledBody: Which app is in front, for how long. Window titles are never read; nothing leaves this PC.
settings.idleBody: Time stops counting after this long without a key or mouse movement.
settings.dayResetBody: Time after midnight counts towards the day before until this hour.
settings.excludedBody: Never counted. Include one again and it counts from now on.
settings.excludedEmpty: No excluded apps. Exclude one from its details in the panel.
settings.exportBody: Every recorded span with its app and category, into a folder you choose.
settings.exportTitle: Choose a folder for the export
settings.clearBody: Deletes every recorded span. Categories, limits and excluded apps stay.

off.title: AI coding is off
off.body: Turn it on in Settings to see your coding agents here.

none.title: No agents running
none.body: Start Claude Code or GitHub Copilot CLI in a terminal and its session shows up here.

hooks.title: No agents running
hooks.body: Copilot CLI sessions show up on their own. For Claude Code, install its hooks in Settings.

error.notWaiting: That session is not waiting any more.
error.noProfile: There is no user profile folder to write the hooks into.
error.hooksFile: Claude Code's settings file could not be changed. Check that it is valid JSON and try again.
error.io: The file could not be written. Try again.
error.failed: That did not work. Try again.

settings.privacy: Sessions are read from the agents' own files on this PC and hooks arrive on 127.0.0.1 only. Prompts stay in the panel; nothing is logged or sent anywhere.
settings.enabledBody: Shows Claude Code and GitHub Copilot CLI sessions in the panel and says when one waits for you.
settings.copilotCliBody: Follows sessions from its session-state folder. Nothing to install.
settings.waitingNoticeBody: The strip says when an agent stops for you, with Allow and Deny when it offers a decision.
settings.receiverBody: Agents post their hooks to Muna over loopback. The panel needs this for Claude Code and for other agents; Copilot CLI works without it.
settings.portBody: Between {{min}} and {{max}}. When the port is taken, the next ten are tried and the live one is shown below.
settings.notListeningBody: The module is off or the port could not be bound.
settings.hookUrlBody: Where Claude Code posts. Other agents use the same address with /hooks/generic.
settings.claudeInstalledBody: Written into Claude Code's settings file. Sessions started after this send their events here.
settings.claudeMissingBody: Adds HTTP hooks to Claude Code's settings so its sessions and permission prompts reach Muna. Nothing else in the file changes.
settings.installed: Hooks installed. Sessions started from now on show up here.
settings.genericBody: Any tool can post JSON to the hook URL with the bearer token written in Claude Code's settings file. The shape is documented in docs/modules/ai-coding.md.

break.title: Time for a break
break.body: Sitting for {{duration}}. Pick a flow, or stand up for a moment.

move.prompt1: Stand up and walk a few steps
move.prompt3: Shake out your arms and legs
move.prompt4: Walk over to get some water
move.prompt5: Look out of a window for a moment

stretch.step1: Neck: tilt your head to each side
stretch.step2: Shoulders: roll them back five times
stretch.step4: Chest: clasp your hands behind you and open up
stretch.step5: Back: twist gently to each side
stretch.step6: Hips: stand up and reach for the ceiling

eyeRest.body: Look at something far away, about 20 feet, until the timer ends.
eyeRest.hint: Blink slowly a few times while you do.

state.offBody: Turn it on in Settings to track sitting and get break reminders.

hearing.body: Loud on headphones: {{percent}} % for {{duration}}. Turn it down a little.

settings.enabled: Track sitting and remind me to take breaks
settings.enabledBody: Uses keyboard and mouse activity only. Nothing leaves this PC.
settings.breakEveryBody: A notice in the notch when you have sat this long; snooze gives you ten more minutes. Sets a goal of {{count}} breaks a day.
settings.waterGoalBody: Glasses per day. Log them from the panel or the dashboard card.
settings.breathePatternBody: Box breathing is even; relax has a long, slow exhale.
settings.windDownBody: From this hour the panel shows you are winding down.
settings.hearingWarningBody: A notice when the volume stays above 85 % on headphones for ten minutes.
settings.resetTodayBody: Clears today's breaks, water and mindful minutes.
settings.clearBody: Removes every day Muna has recorded. Settings stay.

state.offBody: Turn it on in Settings to check your camera before a call. Muna opens the camera only while this panel is on screen.

denied.title: Camera access was refused
denied.body: Windows or another setting blocked the camera. Check Settings › Privacy › Camera, then try again.

notFound.title: No camera found
notFound.body: Connect a camera, or pick another one in the module's settings.

busy.title: The camera is in use
busy.body: Another app has the camera. Close it there, then try again.

unsupported.title: Camera preview is not available
unsupported.body: This window cannot open a camera. Update the WebView2 runtime from Windows Update and try again.

failed.title: The camera did not start
failed.body: Something went wrong opening it. Try again.

settings.enabledBody: Off by default. Muna opens the camera only while the Mirror panel or widget is on screen, never in the background; the camera light shows when it is in use.
settings.flipBody: Shows you the way a mirror would. Turn it off to see what others see.
settings.deviceDefault: The system default. Switch cameras from the panel.

footer.noKey: Add an API key in Settings first
footer.tooLong: Up to {{max}} characters at a time

state.offBody: Turn it on in Settings to translate text with your own provider. Nothing is sent anywhere until you do.

error.disabled: Turn translation on in Settings first.
error.tooLong: That is more than {{max}} characters. Translate it in parts.
error.noKey: Add an API key in Settings first.
error.endpoint: The endpoint is not an address text can go to. Check it in Settings.
error.vault: Windows Credential Manager did not answer. Try again.
error.offline: No connection to {{host}}. Check your network and the endpoint.
error.unauthorized: {{host}} refused the API key. Check it in Settings.
error.rateLimited: {{host}} asked for a pause. Try again in a moment.
error.modelMissing: {{host}} does not have the model {{model}}. Check it in Settings.
error.provider: {{host}} did not answer with a translation. Try again.
error.failed: The translation did not start. Try again.

settings.privacy: Text you translate leaves your PC for the endpoint below, and nowhere else; nothing is sent until you turn this on. The API key stays in Windows Credential Manager, never in the settings file or the logs.
settings.enabledBody: Sends the text you enter to {{host}}.
settings.providerBody: OpenAI-compatible covers OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter and LM Studio. Switching clears the endpoint and model fields.
settings.endpointBody: The API base. Plain http is accepted for local and LAN addresses only.
settings.keySaved: A key is saved for {{provider}}. It is never shown again.
settings.keyRequired: Required by this provider. Saved in Windows Credential Manager.
settings.keyOptional: Optional; most local servers need none.

keyFailed.malformed: That does not look like a key. Paste it again.
keyFailed.vault: Windows Credential Manager did not keep the key. Try again.
keyFailed.failed: The key was not saved. Try again.

settings.languagesBody: The pair the panel starts with. Picking a language in the panel changes it here too.

help.title: Help
help.body: Guides, shortcuts and answers, in your browser

feedback.title: Send feedback
feedback.body: Opens a GitHub issue with your Windows and Muna versions filled in

diagnostics.title: Save diagnostics
diagnostics.body: A zip on your Desktop: logs, settings without secrets and a system report
diagnostics.saved: Saved {{name}} to your Desktop. Attach it to your issue.

empty.title: No release notes in this build
empty.body: The notes for every version are on GitHub.

repair.title: Repair
repair.flyoutsBody: Shows Windows's own flyouts again, then hides them the way the HUD is set.
repair.appBarBody: Registers the space above the notch again if windows overlap it or a gap is left behind.

rate.title: Rate Muna on GitHub
rate.body: A star helps others find it

error.noDesktop: Your Desktop folder cannot be found, so the bundle was not saved.
error.io: The bundle could not be written. Check your Desktop folder and try again.
error.updater: Updates could not be checked. Check your connection and try again.
error.failed: That did not work. Try again.

settings.channelBody: Beta builds arrive earlier and may have rough edges.
settings.checkBody: You have version {{version}}. Muna only checks when you ask.
settings.bundleBody: {{logs}} of logs, your settings without secrets and a system report, zipped to your Desktop.
settings.logsBody: Opens the folder Muna writes its log files to.
settings.repairBody: Use these when something the notch changed in Windows is left behind.

settings.title: Muna settings
settings.error: Settings could not be loaded. Restart Muna and try again.
settings.saveError: Changes could not be saved. Muna is still using the previous values.

search.label: Search settings
search.emptyBody: Try another word, such as “startup”, “screen” or “colour”.

general.launchAtLoginBody: Muna starts in the background when you sign in to Windows.
general.languageBody: Muna switches straight away, in the notch and here. Dates and numbers follow the language you choose; with Windows, they follow your regional format.
general.languageSystemBody: Follows the Windows display language, currently {{name}}.
general.languageDraft: Machine draft, not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
general.hideFromCapturesBody: Screenshots, recordings and screen sharing leave the notch out.
general.tourBody: The first-run steps again: screens, placement, shape and start-up.

layout.defaultsBody: Screens with their own layout in Multiple screens ignore these.
layout.shapeBody: Notch sits flush with the top edge. Island floats as a capsule.
layout.modeBody: Overlay draws over windows and steps aside for full-screen apps. Reserved keeps a band free so maximised windows start below the strip.
layout.stripHeightBody: Compact 26 px, Default 32 px, Comfortable 38 px.

position.offsetsBody: Changes apply to the notch straight away.
position.offsetXBody: From the centre of the screen. Positive moves right.
position.offsetYBody: From the top edge. Island adds its own gap.

screens.body: Each screen follows the defaults until you give it its own layout.
screens.useDefaultsBody: Turn off to give this screen its own shape, placement and offsets.
screens.enabled: Show the notch on this screen
screens.enabledBody: Off parks the notch for this screen only.
screens.emptyBody: Connect a screen and reopen settings.

appearance.accentBody: Used for toggles, the active module and the focus ring.
appearance.reduceMotionBody: Replaces springs with quick fades. Muna also follows the Windows animation effects setting.

modules.body: Switch a module off to hide it from the notch. Arrange the module bar with the arrows.
modules.emptyBody: Modules arrive with updates and appear here with their own settings.

about.openLogsBody: Log files help when reporting a problem. They never contain notification text.
about.exportBody: Saves a JSON file you can import on another PC.
about.importBody: Replaces the current settings with a file exported by Muna.
about.resetBody: Restores every setting to its default. Modules keep their data.
about.resetQuestion: Reset every setting to its default?

welcome.title: Welcome to Muna
welcome.body: A notch for Windows. Media, battery and live activities sit at the top of your screen, out of the way until you look.
welcome.steps: A few choices take a minute. Everything here can be changed later in Settings.

displays.title: Choose your screens
displays.body: The notch shows on every screen that is on here. Each screen can get its own layout later in Multiple screens.

placement.title: Choose how it sits
placement.overlayBody: Draws over windows and steps aside when a title bar sits under it.
placement.reservedBody: Keeps a band free, so maximised windows start below the strip.
placement.overlayCaption: The strip steps aside while a title bar sits under it, and comes back when it moves.
placement.reservedCaption: Maximised windows stop below the strip, at the cost of a band of screen.

shape.title: Pick a shape
shape.body: Both do the same things. Island floats a little lower, which suits browser-heavy days.
shape.notchBody: Sits flush with the top edge, like a MacBook.
shape.islandBody: Floats as a capsule with a small gap above it.

permissions.title: What Muna will ask for
permissions.body: Nothing is requested now. Each permission is asked for the first time a module needs it, and each one can be turned off again.
permissions.bluetoothBody: Battery levels of connected earbuds, keyboards and mice.
permissions.notificationsBody: Toasts in the strip and a place to triage them. Available in the Store and MSIX builds.
permissions.cameraBody: The mirror module uses the webcam only while its panel is open.

startup.title: Start with Windows
startup.body: Muna is a small tray app. Launching at login keeps the notch there whenever you sign in.
startup.launchAtLoginBody: Starts in the background when you sign in to Windows.

done.title: All set
done.body: The notch is on your screen. Rest the pointer on it to peek, click to open, and right-click for settings.
done.hint: Everything you chose lives in Settings, along with the modules and their order.
